يستلهمان (form X)
# يَسْتَلْهِمَانِ (yastalhimāni) /jas.tal.hi.maː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
# يُسْتَلْهَمَانِ (yustalhamāni) /jus.tal.ha.maː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
